name: Responsible engineer
purpose: Engineers retain responsibility for engineering decisions. Identify the actual reviewer before adoption of changed obligations, design decisions or adequacy claims.
interfaces: Project-owned review gates and decision records
license: Original collection guidance; not a qualification or support claim
limits: No appointed reviewer or accepted decision is inferred from this diagram.

name: Clarify material unknowns
purpose: Ask about unresolved assumptions, criteria or authority when they could change the engineering result. Continue authorized investigation while dependent conclusions remain pending.
interfaces: Project-owned review gates and decision records
license: Original collection guidance; not a qualification or support claim
limits: No appointed reviewer or accepted decision is inferred from this diagram.

name: Review and decision record
purpose: Bind an actual human disposition to the artifact revision, evidence scope, open questions and acceptance conditions. Passing checks, agent agreement and silence are not acceptance.
interfaces: Project-owned review gates and decision records
license: Original collection guidance; not a qualification or support claim
limits: No appointed reviewer or accepted decision is inferred from this diagram.
